---
title: "Data on media coverage on sports"
author: Trinity harden
---

This graphic uses the Sports News dataset from [NewsData.io](https://github.com/newsdataapi/newsdata.io-free-datasets), licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Each point represents one article.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(archive)

archive_url <- "https://github.com/newsdataapi/newsdata.io-free-datasets/raw/refs/heads/main/Sports_News.7z"
archive_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".7z")
download.file(archive_url, archive_path, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)

archive::archive_extract(archive_path, dir = tempdir())

sports_news <- read_csv(
  file.path(tempdir(), "Sports_News", "Sports_News.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    pubDate = as.POSIXct(pubDate, tz = "UTC"),
    headline_chars = str_length(title)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(pubDate), !is.na(headline_chars))

stopifnot(nrow(sports_news) >= 1000)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
ggplot(sports_news, aes(x = pubDate, y = headline_chars)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.7, color = "#2166AC") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "12 hours", date_labels = "%b %d\n%H:%M") +
  labs(
    title = "Sports news article headlines over time",
    subtitle = paste(format(nrow(sports_news), big.mark = ","), "articles; one point per article"),
    x = "Publication time",
    y = "Headline length (characters)",
    caption = "Source: NewsData.io Sports News dataset (CC BY 4.0)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

The available data covers only October 24–26, 2021, and does not include gender labels. This graphic describes article timing and headline length; it cannot measure gender balance in sports coverage.
